items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: Mayor Maestrie, he sent word and he told me, anything we needed, we could have.

ctx.x: Bill Bailey, once the piece come over.

They forgot whatever they had. Whatever they had, they forgot. Here was Lizzie Miles, Bill Bailey, and Papa Celisna, he said, now you know Miss Senegal, took you to bring us back together again. And they really, really did put it on that night. We really had a wonderful concert. That was the beginning of our fiesta, right there. And it was all given to us. Given to us. All given to us. From the city on down. And Mayor Maestrie, he sent word and he told me, anything we needed, we could have. Any city equipment…
